sentences.en: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
sentences.zh: 皮埃尔的电脑里有很多盗版软件。

sentences.en: My software never has bugs. It just has random features.
sentences.zh: 我的软件没有bug，它只是有一些随机功能。

sentences.en: Do you have the most recent version of this software?
sentences.zh: 你有这个软件的最新版本吗？
